column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:logic-util module
# Derived boolean connectives moved out of core into the LogicUtil
# namespace. The everyday connectives (and, or, not, xor, any, all) stay
# built-in; these are the second-tier ones:
aql:logic-util import end LogicUtil.nand true true
aql:logic-util import end LogicUtil.nor false false
aql:logic-util import end LogicUtil.iff true true
aql:logic-util import end LogicUtil.xnor true false
aql:logic-util import end LogicUtil.implies false true
# §2  negative — the words are gone from core (unbound without import)

column3: derived connectives are no longer core
